prompt:
Production Unity Tank sprite animation sheet, redraw reference identity in exact front three-quarter DOWN-RIGHT view in every frame. Single reference sets silhouette: very broad heavy rock-armored quadruped, dark brown matte boulder plates, pale gray-white muscular legs, amber eye slit. Clean pre-rendered painterly 3D, fixed elevated 45deg camera and soft upper-left light. FOUR legs only. Keep the tank broad and squat, not long or insectlike.
EXACT FOUR columns x SIX rows =24 full drawings. Tall PORTRAIT canvas, aspect2:3, evenly sized square cells. Body armor must remain THE SAME PIXEL SIZE in all 24 frames (leg articulation naturally changes footprint). Each whole creature fits middle65% of its cell, generous alpha0 gutters on every side; no touching or cut feet. Do not make early rows smaller or death rows larger.
Rows1-2: EIGHT sequential heavy WALK frames, four legs take distinct weight-bearing steps, alternating diagonal pairs, subtle weight shift, stable armor. Row3: FOUR IDLE breathing poses, planted feet. Row4: FOUR shockwave WINDUP frames: hind legs brace, front limbs and chest gradually lift a little, ready to pound ground, preserve full anatomy. Row5: FOUR SLAM/RECOVERY frames: FIRST frame both front feet firmly strike ground with head lowered, then armored body absorbs impact, shoulders recoil and settles; no drawn shockwave, dust, debris or ground. Row6: FOUR DEATH frames, heavy legs progressively lose support, armor settles flat, head rests, amber eye darkens.
Windup raises front feet and braces rear feet; first slam frame firmly plants both front feet, followed by recoil. Death softly collapses legs WITHOUT spreading the body twice as wide. Eight genuine continuous walk poses. Maintain armor structure, consistent scale and camera direction, grounded foot anchor. No copied identical poses, no rotations or overall scale transforms. Transparent alpha0 background AND leg gaps, no floor/shadow/text/grid/projectile/dust/VFX.
